title: THE MAGNET NEVER MOVES A BOX
why: From the cloud review of the party builds, and his order that the magnet pull loose loot to the picker and never containers. The magnet used to slide wrecks, bodies and the stronghold cache toward the player. The stronghold cache and the convoy crate could be pulled out through a shut fence by anyone standing at it, and in co-op each window moved its own copy of a box, so the host answered player 2's search with too far for a box that was at his feet on his screen, and the host's own magnet pulled boxes that never moved for player 2. No container moves now. The magnet pulls the pickups on the floor to the player, the same in both windows.
now: The magnet pulls pickups to you and never moves a body, a wreck or a cache.
